android.desc:
Alley Cat Band is a vertical rhythm game starring a punk band of neighborhood street cats. Black tiles slide down from the record at the top of the screen. Hit them on the line and the tuxedo drummer and the ginger guitarist rock out on every beat.

How to play

- Tap each tile as it reaches the line on one of the three lanes.
- Hold long tiles to the end and swipe arrow tiles in their direction.
- The closer you are to the beat, the closer you get to PERFECT+. Earn up to five stars per song.

Features

- Original songs made for the band, with new ones added along the way, from the bouncy 100 BPM funk pop of Laser Pointer to the 187 BPM ska rush of Rooftop Chase. Your first gig opens with the band's theme song, Nyan Riot.
- Every song comes in Easy, Normal and Hard. Hard adds two-lane hits and taps while you hold a long tile.
- No menus between songs: the band picks tonight's three-song gig, you press PLAY, then NEXT SONG. Finish the gig to open a chest and move from the back alley up to a world tour.
- Want a certain song? Swipe the record, roll the dice, heart your favorites or open the full song list.
- Keep your streak alive to climb to x2, x3 and x4. At x4 Nyan Fever turns the stage rainbow, and one miss drops you a step.
- Catch the golden paw tile at the end of each stage for a big bonus.
- Lose a big combo and claw marks scratch the lane while the cats jump in shock.
- Miss too often and your life runs out and the stage stops. Spend fish to keep playing once.
- Earn fish every song. Three daily missions, streak gifts and a song of the day that pays double keep every day fresh, and fish unlock paw stamps and stage colors.
- No misses means FULL COMBO. Every hit PERFECT+ means ALL PURRFECT.
- A calm effects option tones down screen shake and flashes.
- When new songs are added, you get them without updating the app.

Good to know

Free to play with ads. Ads appear only now and then when you move on after finishing a song, never during play. No in-app purchases and no account needed. Songs download the first time you pick them, and downloaded songs play offline. Your play records stay on your device. To show ads, Google AdMob may process some information such as device identifiers. A short tutorial teaches the controls on first launch.

Contact
